sources.title: D-Robotics/hobot_locateanything - GitHub
sources.snippet: Model Overview LocateAnything is an open-semantic visual grounding model. It performs object detection, referring expression grounding, GUI and text grounding, document layout grounding, and point localization from text instructions. PBD (Parallel Box Decoding) generates bounding-box coordinates in parallel.

sources.title: GitHub - D-Robotics/rdk_model_zoo
sources.snippet: This repository is the official collection of BPU model examples and tools (Model Zoo) provided by D-Robotics. It is oriented towards AI model deployment and application development on BPU (Brain Processing Unit), helping developers to quickly get started with BPU and fast-track model inference workflows.
